page_index=0
page_limit=20
all_following=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('following page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_following.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('total_following_artists', len(all_following))
following_ids=set(a['artist_id'] for a in all_following)
need_follow_set=set(need_follow)  # from earlier

missing=[aid for aid in need_follow_set if aid not in following_ids]
print('missing_reggae_artists_after_follow', missing)
print('followed_reggae_artists_after_follow', [reggae_artist_id_to_name[aid] for aid in sorted(need_follow_set) if aid in following_ids])
